'''B4-T9''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] at the ancient [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Hypergate]] on [[Seline]],<ref name="Seline" /> as well as the [[Voidstar]], which were contested between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
B4-T9 appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor of consummables for the PVP Warzone on Seline and the [[Voidstar]].<ref name="Seline" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
